name: mirage
text: Why 6: this phone only holds the rows the GitHub list sends it (6 right now), and the Arb tab compared just those. The engine itself compares every Novig line it prices (about 9,400) against Kalshi on each scan, and it found no sure profit either. I changed the Arb tab's note so it also says what the engine checked and found. It will ship in the next app release. The tab still can't list or place an engine-found arb, because that needs the full Novig row on the phone. If you want that, I'll make the engine publish the arb with everything the phone needs.
